# telnyx_agent_gateway_team_tool_permissions (Resource)

The MCP servers and APIs, and their tools, that an Agent Gateway team may call. Each apply replaces the whole grant; destroy grants none.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Each apply replaces the team's whole grant. An empty tools list covers every
# tool of that server.
resource "telnyx_agent_gateway_team_tool_permissions" "support" {
  gateway_id = telnyx_agent_gateway.example.id
  team_id    = telnyx_agent_gateway_team.support.id
  servers = [
    { id = telnyx_agent_gateway_mcp_server.docs.id, tools = ["search"] },
    { id = telnyx_agent_gateway_api.billing.id, tools = [] },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gateway_id` (String) The gateway id.
- `servers` (Attributes Set) The servers granted, each with its tools. `[]` grants none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))
- `team_id` (String) The team id.

<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Required:

- `id` (String) An MCP server's or API's `id` on the instance.

Optional:

- `tools` (List of String) The tools the grant covers, by name without the server prefix. `[]` covers every tool the server exposes.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_agent_gateway_team_tool_permissions.support <gateway_id>/<team_id>
```
